# Normalize to surface area
```{r}

# Load cell data
sym <- read_csv("data/cells_data.csv")

#calculate the average of two counts
sym.mean <- sym %>%
  group_by(colony_id)%>%
  summarize(mean.cell.count = count.ul.1 * count.ul.2 / 2)

write_csv(sym.mean, path = "output/cell_density_list.csv")

# Load homogenate volume
homog.vol <- read_csv("data/homogenate_vols.csv") %>%
  select(colony_id, homog_vol_ml)
sym.mean <- full_join(sym.mean, homog.vol)

# Load surface area
sa <- read_csv("output/surface_area_calculated.csv")
sym.mean <- full_join(sym.mean, sa)

# Multiply by the homogenate volume and divide by surface area
sym.mean <- sym.mean %>%  
  mutate(cells.cm2 = mean.cell.count * homog_vol_ml / surface.area.cm2)

meta <- read_csv("data/Master_Sample_List.csv")
sym.mean <- right_join(sym.mean, meta, by = "colony_id") 

# write  data to file
sym.mean %>%
  select(colony_id, cells.cm2) %>%
  write_csv(path = "output/cell_density.csv")
```

# Plot results by species and site
```{r, eval = TRUE}

# Plot data
sym.mean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Date.Sampled.Tank), y = cells.cm2, color = species)) +
  facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Sym Density (cells/cm2)") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +                                            # Plot all points
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, fun.args = list(mult = 1),    # Plot standard error
               geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", color = "black")           # Plot mean

```
